name: Ebirri
description: A feline rakshasa demon who bound himself to Taigam as his true master and kills the Jeskai assassins with dark magic.

timeline.summary: Flashback: the rakshasa Ebirri offers Taigam power in the Sultai, and Taigam pledges his life to the rakshasa.
timeline.quote: Taigam swore his life in service of the rakshasa.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Taigam rises to chief advisor of Sidisi, who sends him to enforce her decrees, watched by Ebirri.
timeline.quote: Taigam rose to chief advisor of Sidisi, the kahn of the Sultai.

timeline.summary: Taigam humiliates an elder of Kishla, then has a guard take one of his three children.
Ebirri fights the monks and kills two while Taigam, freeing himself, stabs the rakshasa, who then crushes a monk's head; Ebirri reminds Taigam he owns him.
Taigam learns that Narset sent the surviving monk, has the monk crushed, and suspects the monks were zealots acting without her.
timeline.quote: They were zealots, most likely acting without her knowledge.

timeline.summary: Taigam resolves to handle the Jeskai threat himself and has the dead monks sized for golden uniforms.
timeline.quote: Taigam signaled the sibsig to keep the boat moving as he began to size the intact dead monks for golden uniforms.

relations.note: Taigam swore his life in service of the rakshasa.
relations.quote: Taigam swore his life in service of the rakshasa.

relations.note: Ebirri crushes and chokes the Jeskai assassins.
relations.quote: Ebirri crushed it, exploding brain and skull all over the cabin.
